_comment: v1.3 per-persona model presets. tier -> {model, variant?}. Authored here in root lib/; build.sh copies to .opencode/lib/. The config hook (plugins/devils-council.ts) reads this and the persona model_tier sidecars, then per-field guarded-injects agent.<name>.{model,variant}. Selector: env DEVILS_COUNCIL_MODEL_PRESET (bedrock|budget|cheap|off); unset => off + one-time hint. Preset names are validated against the keys here, so adding a preset needs no code change.

budget._comment: Evidence-backed low-cost preset (see .planning/model-study FINDINGS addendum). big-pickle scored 7.5/9 reasoning with ZERO fabrication on deep cells (vs haiku 5.0 which fabricated), matches all models on recall, and is opencode-hosted at no marginal Bedrock cost. Safer for deep-reasoning than haiku.
